---
title: "Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte Karbalai Brothers Lyrics 2024"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Asghar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte Karbalai Brothers.
Ho Rahe Hain Mukamal Bahatar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Hur Chala Hai Bananey Muqadar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Yeh Bhi Tha Aik Kar-e-Risalat Samne Jab Bhi Aati Thi Hujjat.
Apni Masnad Se Uthay Payamber Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Kainat-e-Do Aalam Hi Kya Hain Anbiya-o-Wali Iss Jahan Mein.
Khalq Karta Raha Rab-e-Akbar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Rab Se Tafseer-e-Ismat Jo Mangi Ho Baho Apni Madar Ke Jaisi.
Mil Gayi Shah-e-Wala Ko Dukhtar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Har Kissi Ko Ijazat Kahan Thi Khaki Sab They Magar Yeh They Nori.
Aaye Jibreel Youn Zair-e-Chadar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Muflisi Ka Barha Jab Andhera Tu Asar Tha Hadees-e-Kisa Ka.
Khud Howa Ghar Hamara Munawar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Saya Karti Rahein Gi Wafaein Maula Abbas Dein Gay Duaein.
Jab Alam Main Lagaon Ga Chat Par Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Hashar Mein Pohanchay Halqa Bana Kar Khuld Ke Khultay Jate They Sab Dar.
Matami Pohanchay Janat Ke Andar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Ik Tasawar Zehan Mein Bana Ke Unn Ki Chakki Ko Choma Tha Main Ne.
Tham Gaye Meri Qismat Ke Chakar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Jo Khuda Ne Banaya Woh Mana Hai Aqeeda Yehi Bas Hamara.
Aaye Ga Gaib Se Apna Rehbar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Tha Chuna Shahzadi Ne Jin Ko Pyasay Qurbaan Hoye Shah Par Jo.
Pe Rahe Hain Woh Ab Aab-e-Kausar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Al-Madad Ya Ali Keh Ke Nikla Saaf Hota Raha Oss Ka Rasta.
Nehar Tak Aaya Shair-e-Ghazanfar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Gasibon Ka Bataney Ko Shajrah Unn Ki Naslon Pe Karne Tabarah.
Aayi Darbar Mein Sheh Ki Khwahar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Gar Aqeeda Kabhi Ho Na Madhum Marifat Barhti Jati Hai Oss Dam.
Ban Hi Jate Hain Salman-o-Buzar Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Chahe Badar-o-Ohad Ho Ya Khaybar Dushmanan-e-Muhammad Se Lar Kar.
Jeet Jate They Har Jang Haider Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
Bolay Asghar, Naqi Jab Bhi Baithein Shair Midhat Ke Kuch Naqsh Kar Dein.
Manqabat Main Ne Likhi Hai Far Far Fatima Fatima Kehte Kehte.
